build_BaseMamba_model: build a BaseMamba model using BaseMambaArgs to configure dim, n_layers, n_heads, and state_dim
create_SSM_module: create an SSM module with configurable hidden_dim, state_dim, n_heads, conv_size, and chunk_size parameters
create_MambaBlock_layer: create a MambaBlock layer with RMSNorm and SSM using BaseMambaArgs for dimension and head configuration
configure_BaseMambaArgs: configure a BaseMambaArgs dataclass to set model hyperparameters like dim, n_layers, conv_size, and init_args
init_weights_BaseMamba: initialize BaseMamba model weights using init_weights with depth-based or disabled standard deviation factors
